-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.bbolt.Options` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

structure bbolt.OptsM : Type where
  readOnly : Bool
  pageSize : w64
  openFile : GoFunc
  logger : GoInterface
  mlock : Bool
  mmapFlags : w64

def bbolt.OptsM.ok (o : bbolt.OptsM) : Prop :=
  o.readOnly = false ∧
    o.pageSize = W64 0 ∧
      o.openFile = func.nil ∧
        o.mlock = false ∧
          (BitVec.toNat o.mmapFlags = 0 ∨ BitVec.toNat o.mmapFlags = bbolt.mapPopulate) ∧ bbolt.loggerPtrOk o.logger

def (sealed) bbolt.optsAt (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (o : bbolt.OptsM) : IProp GF

theorem bbolt.optsZero_ok : bbolt.optsZero.ok

def bbolt.mapPopulate : Nat :=
  32768

def bbolt.loggerPtrOk : GoInterface → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | GoInterface.nil => True
  | GoInterface.ok li => ∃ t, li.ty = t.PointerType

def bbolt.optsZero : bbolt.OptsM :=
  { readOnly := false, pageSize := W64 0, openFile := func.nil, logger := GoInterface.nil, mlock := false,
    mmapFlags := W64 0 }
